1.title: 概覽
content: 透過身體強化，![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)災害（Hazard）能在敵方隊伍周圍跳躍，並利用危險的 ![](/data/assets/guide/860a1f6211acadb3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjagged-wall.png)鋸齒之牆（Jagged Wall）困住他們。這道可部署的牆體積夠大，足以封鎖大多數門口，並可用於切斷敵人試圖使用的入口與逃生路徑。當他在交戰期間將牆體作為防禦屏障來保護自己時，同樣非常有效。

身為一名 ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)坦克（Tank），他相當全面，並不完全符合任何傳統的 ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)坦克（Tank）分類。他的霰彈槍、牆體與格擋使他成為稱職的前線鬥士，而躍擊（Leap）與 ![](/data/assets/guide/0288db79a40ae52f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fvault.png)跳躍（Vault）也賦予了他突襲的能力。如果你希望在比賽中能快速切換防禦與進攻風格，![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)災害（Hazard）會是一個絕佳的 ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)坦克（Tank）選擇。

1.1.1.title: 遊玩方式
content: * 使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/860a1f6211acadb3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjagged-wall.png)鋸齒之牆（Jagged Wall）來阻斷敵方的視野（LoS）。你可以藉此保護自己免受傷害，或是將敵人與其隊友隔開。

* 時刻保持移動並重新調整位置。![](/data/assets/guide/0288db79a40ae52f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fvault.png)跳躍（Vault）沒有冷卻時間，且 ![](/data/assets/guide/121d222c0195922b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fviolent-leap.png)猛烈躍擊（Violent Leap）的冷卻時間很短。![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)災害（Hazard）在移動時表現最佳，絕不應該待在同一個地方不動。

* 儘早使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/c47191eac4c3da8b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fspike-guard.png)尖刺護衛（Spike Guard）來維持護甲並獲取敵方位置資訊。進行突襲，然後再次使用護衛來擊殺目標，並存活足夠長的時間以躍擊（Leap）離開。

1.1.2.title: 對戰策略
content: * 每當你看到 ![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)災害（Hazard）使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/c47191eac4c3da8b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fspike-guard.png)尖刺防禦（Spike Guard）時，請對他使用你的控場技能。
* 規劃好你該如何在他突襲時存活下來。你可以使用逃生技能、傷害減免、暈眩效果，或是移動到能協助你的隊友身邊。

* 必要時進行英雄更換（Counterswap）。範例：![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)安娜（Ana）可以使用睡眠鏢和禁療瓶來對付他；![](/data/assets/guide/ec8f0896ca78ec6f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fecho.png)迴音（Echo）可以避開他，並在他防禦結束後利用爆發連技將其擊殺；![](/data/assets/guide/492c99cc430727c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Froadhog.png)攔路豬（Roadhog）可以使用肉鉤（Hook）來中斷他的突襲。

2.title: 優勢與劣勢總結
content: * 機動位移能力（Mobile Movement Abilities）
* 擁有大型防禦牆（Big wall）
* 高運作時間（High uptime）
* 必須處於近戰範圍（Melee range）
* 短距離機動性（Short mobility）
* 對抗控場效果（CC）時較為吃力

3.1.1.title: 多種機動工具
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)災害（Hazard）可以攀爬牆壁與邊緣、進行跳躍（Leap）以及兔跳（bunny hop）。在必要時，他甚至可以![](/data/assets/guide/0288db79a40ae52f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fvault.png)翻越（Vault）![](/data/assets/guide/860a1f6211acadb3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjagged-wall.png)鋸齒之牆（Jagged Wall）。只要妥善進行站位並管理冷卻時間，你就不應該會遇到沒有機動選項的情況。

3.1.2.title: 可部署牆體
content: 作為唯一擁有可部署牆體的 ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)戰士，同時也是除了 ![](/data/assets/guide/83501cfadb6150e1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmei.png)小美之外唯一具備此能力的英雄，![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)災害能夠執行其他 ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)戰士無法做到的戰術。這道牆體在封鎖門口、作為屏障使用、隔離敵人、切斷敵方撤退路線，以及造成少量傷害方面同樣出色。

3.1.3.title: 高運作時間
content: 憑藉多種強大的能力與短暫的冷卻循環，![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)災害（Hazard）從不需要在交戰前枯等資源恢復。與許多其他圍繞著單一長冷卻時間能力作為核心戰術的 ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)坦克（Tanks）相比，![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)災害（Hazard）能將更多時間投入在激烈的戰鬥之中。

3.2.1.title: 必須近身作戰
content: 「斬擊（Slash）」與 ![](/data/assets/guide/e333ac66d1d49141.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbonespur.png)「骨刺（Bonespur）」僅在極近距離下有效。根據地圖與敵方隊伍陣容，![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)災害（Hazard）可能會在試圖接近敵人的過程中，因受到遠程消耗而浪費大量時間。

3.2.2.title: 短距離位移
content: 雖然他並非傳統意義上真正的突擊型（Dive）![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)坦克，但他的遊玩風格卻非常相似。然而，與其他突擊型（Dive）![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)坦克相比，他的移動範圍相當有限。![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)災害（Hazard）在追擊那些擁有自身位移與逃脫手段的敵人時會感到相當吃力。

3.2.3.title: 容易受到控場影響
content: 由於缺乏屏障且 ![](/data/assets/guide/860a1f6211acadb3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjagged-wall.png)鋸齒之牆（Jagged Wall）僅有一次使用機會，![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)災害（Hazard）特別容易受到控場技能的影響。如果敵方隊伍擁有具備暈眩和位移能力的英雄，請預期在每次使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/c47191eac4c3da8b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fspike-guard.png)尖刺護衛（Spike Guard）時都會成為目標。緩慢且可預測的移動方式，使 ![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)災害（Hazard）成為容易被鎖定的目標。

4.1.title: 主要攻擊：骨刺（Bonespur）
content: **![](/data/assets/guide/e333ac66d1d49141.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbonespur.png)骨刺（Bonespur）的操作技巧**
* 在接近時進行消耗
* 不要只是乾等完美的時機。一旦看到敵人，你就可以開始施加消耗壓力。

* 面對擁有護盾的 ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)戰士（Tanks）時，距離並不是太大的問題，你很擅長削減他們的護盾生命值。
* 利用掩體
* 你的遠程傷害能力幾乎比其他所有英雄都差，所以你不會想要陷入全面的遠程對戰。射擊時利用掩體進行探頭，以將你受到的傷害降至最低。
* 在全面交戰前重新裝填

* ![](/data/assets/guide/e333ac66d1d49141.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbonespur.png)骨刺（Bonespur）是你主要的傷害手段，所以如果你一直在進行消耗，請確保在跳入敵方隊伍前完成重新裝填。

* ![](/data/assets/guide/c47191eac4c3da8b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fspike-guard.png)尖刺護衛（Spike Guard）會自動重新裝填，所以如果你正準備格擋，就無需手動重新裝填。

4.2.title: 次要攻擊：尖刺防禦（Spike Guard）
content: **![](/data/assets/guide/c47191eac4c3da8b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fspike-guard.png)尖刺防禦（Spike Guard）的使用技巧**
* 保持你的護甲值
* 不要等到快死了才開始格擋。最佳的格擋時機是你擁有充足護甲值的時候，而不是瀕死之際。這樣當你再次發動攻擊時，你依然有足夠的護甲來承受傷害。
* 終結敵人

* 自動觸發的傷害對於收割生命值偏低的敵人非常有效。它保證命中、能為你的主要攻擊填裝彈藥，並能為你的 ![](/data/assets/guide/28f559449d0692f6.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Fsupport.svg)醫護兵（Supports）爭取治療你的時間。
* 存活於爆發傷害中

* ![](/data/assets/guide/c47191eac4c3da8b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fspike-guard.png)尖刺防禦（Spike Guard）能減少 65% 的所有正面直接傷害。只要你不是貼在爆炸點旁邊，你甚至可以存活於 D.Va 的自爆之下。
* 當你看到即將到來的爆發傷害時，請務必嘗試跳躍（Leap）並立即進行格擋。
* 減少治療資源的消耗

* 身為一名沒有護盾的 ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)坦克（Tank），你的職責依然是盡可能減少受到的傷害。不要成為一個只會吸收子彈、耗盡隊伍治療資源的肉盾。如果兩名 ![](/data/assets/guide/28f559449d0692f6.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Fsupport.svg)醫護兵（Supports）必須不斷地治療你，這會導致你的隊友很快被擊殺。
* 防禦技能冷卻恢復很快，請頻繁使用格擋。

4.3.title: [SHIFT]：暴力躍擊（Violent Leap）
content: **![](/data/assets/guide/121d222c0195922b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fviolent-leap.png)暴力躍擊（Violent Leap）的使用技巧**
* 循序漸進地佔據空間

* 暴力躍擊不像 ![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)溫斯頓、![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王、![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va 或 ![](/data/assets/guide/2d37d713fbda6bee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwrecking-ball.png)火爆鋼球那樣能讓你跨越整個地圖。因此，你需要以暴力躍擊的距離為單位分段推進。
* 躍擊至最近的掩體、進行騷擾並使用防禦（Guard），然後躍擊至下一個能讓你更接近目標的掩體，直到最終進入突襲範圍。
* 進場與撤退

* 別忘了 ![](/data/assets/guide/121d222c0195922b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fviolent-leap.png)暴力躍擊同時也是一個逃生工具。雖然你主要會用它來發動攻擊，但它也非常適合用來撤退至安全位置。
* 兔子跳（Bunnyhop）
* 躍擊並在落地瞬間跳躍來執行兔子跳。你將能保持慣性並跳得更遠。
* 你也可以在兔子跳後才使用斬擊（Slash），藉此有效延長其移動距離。
* 在空中使用其他技能

* 不要只是在空中飄浮，試著攻擊或部署 ![](/data/assets/guide/860a1f6211acadb3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjagged-wall.png)鋸齒之牆（Jagged Wall）。這對於額外傷害和連招非常有效。

* 最佳連招：![](/data/assets/guide/121d222c0195922b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fviolent-leap.png)暴力躍擊 → ![](/data/assets/guide/e333ac66d1d49141.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbonespur.png)骨刺（Bonespur）（主要攻擊） → ![](/data/assets/guide/121d222c0195922b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fviolent-leap.png)暴力躍擊斬擊 → ![](/data/assets/guide/e333ac66d1d49141.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbonespur.png)骨刺（Bonespur） → 近戰攻擊

4.4.title: [E]：鋸齒之牆（Jagged Wall）
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/860a1f6211acadb3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjagged-wall.png)鋸齒之牆（Jagged Wall）的使用技巧

* 在英雄設定中開啟「![](/data/assets/guide/860a1f6211acadb3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjagged-wall.png)鋸齒之牆（Jagged Wall）使用預先放置控制」，
* 這能讓牆體的精確放置變得更加容易。
* 切斷視線（LoS）

* 鋸齒之牆（Jagged Wall）的主要用途是阻擋敵方的視線。你可以在身前部署牆體來阻擋遠程消耗傷害，或是放置在敵人與其![](/data/assets/guide/28f559449d0692f6.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Fsupport.svg)支援（Support）之間，以切斷他們的治療來源。
* 保護你的側翼

* 當你正在突襲敵方後排時，敵方隊伍的其他成員會轉過頭來試圖擊殺你。在身後放置![](/data/assets/guide/860a1f6211acadb3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjagged-wall.png)鋸齒之牆（Jagged Wall）來保護自己免受反擊，這樣你就能專注於進攻。
* 封鎖入口與逃生路徑

* ![](/data/assets/guide/860a1f6211acadb3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjagged-wall.png)鋸齒之牆（Jagged Wall）的體積足以封鎖門口。這非常適合在敵人試圖爭奪目標點時拖延時間，或是將他們彼此隔開。
* 當你在攻擊試圖逃跑的敵人時，將牆體射在他們的路徑上，以阻止他們逃脫。

4.5.title: [SPACE]：金庫（Vault）
content: **![](/data/assets/guide/0288db79a40ae52f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fvault.png)金庫（Vault）的技巧**
* 移動

* * 由於 ![](/data/assets/guide/0288db79a40ae52f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fvault.png)金庫（Vault）沒有冷卻時間，你應該盡可能使用它，並保留 ![](/data/assets/guide/121d222c0195922b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fviolent-leap.png)猛烈跳躍（Violent Leap）。在準備突襲時，利用爬牆來佔據高處，或是跳過牆壁以接近目標。
* 閃避

* * 你可以透過爬牆讓自己更難被擊中。特別是在面對像 ![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)萊因哈特（Reinhardt）這類近距離英雄時，爬牆非常適合用來脫離錘擊範圍並閃避裂地重擊（Shatter）。
* 爬牆重置

* * 在爬牆後使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/121d222c0195922b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fviolent-leap.png)猛烈跳躍（Violent Leap），能讓 ![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)災害（Hazard）在無需觸地的情況下再次爬牆。

4.6.title: 絕招：傾盆大雨（Downpour）
content: **![](/data/assets/guide/eeafb396dbd4850f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdownpour.png)傾盆大雨（Downpour）的使用技巧**
* 可穿透牆壁

* 無論路徑上有多少牆壁或建築物，![](/data/assets/guide/eeafb396dbd4850f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdownpour.png)傾盆大雨（Downpour）的尖刺都能直接穿透。

* 利用 ![](/data/assets/guide/c47191eac4c3da8b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fspike-guard.png)尖刺防護（Spike Guard）以第三人稱視角探查轉角，確認敵人的位置。接著，用 ![](/data/assets/guide/eeafb396dbd4850f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdownpour.png)傾盆大雨（Downpour）命中他們。隱蔽的路徑會讓敵人更難閃避。
* 會被屏障以及能吸收或摧毀投射物的技能所阻擋

* 例如，![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)席格馬（Sigma）可以在頭頂部署護盾，或是將 ![](/data/assets/guide/7486123dd5edc842.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fkinetic-grasp.png)動能補捉（Kinetic Grasp）對準上方來抵銷你的絕招。如果你想命中他（或任何擁有這類技能的英雄），你需要等待他們交出冷卻技能後再行動。
* 對於淨化技能和逃生技能也是同樣的道理，因為絕招漫長的啟動動畫，加上對遠處敵人所需的飛行時間，給了他們充足的時間進行閃避。
* 保持聰明
* 當敵人被定身時，他們仍然可以攻擊你。他們只是無法移動而已。你不能直接 1v5 殲滅對手或盲目進攻。請務必利用掩體，並確保有隊友的資源支援你。
* 可將飛行單位拉下

* ![](/data/assets/guide/eeafb396dbd4850f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdownpour.png)傾盆大雨（Downpour）擁有高達 30 公尺的垂直作用範圍。除非敵人飛得非常高，否則你都能用絕招將他們拉下來。

5.1.1.title: 深淵之躍（Deep Leap）
5.1.1.description: 猛烈之躍（Violent Leap）的距離增加 15%。
content: 反制高機動性

* ![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)災害（Hazard）在追擊擁有高機動性的目標時會感到吃力，例如 ![](/data/assets/guide/13c0663d738c73ee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjuno.png)朱諾（Juno）、![](/data/assets/guide/c7d7f2bfb765e77e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmercy.png)慈悲（Mercy）以及 ![](/data/assets/guide/0df66e1c25a77a79.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsojourn.png)索潔恩（Sojourn）。額外的跳躍距離能幫助他縮短差距，並維持在他更有利的戰鬥範圍內。
更快速的交戰
* 隨著距離增加，你不需要將進場過程拆解成多個階段，因為你可以從更遠的地方進行俯衝。
你將能更頻繁地繞過敵方前線，並利用跳躍瞬間抵達後排。
與「從天而降（Off The Top）」搭配
* 你可以將資源全數投入在跳躍相關的特殊能力（perks）上，並圍繞著跳躍與斬擊（Slash）來規劃你的戰術。但請注意，這麼做會犧牲掉生命竊取（Lifesteal）與牆體持續時間（Wall uptime）。

5.1.2.title: 無政府狂熱（Anarchic Zeal）
5.1.2.description: 尖刺守衛（Spike Guard）的尖刺獲得 30% 的吸血效果。
content: 自我治療

* 擁有無政府狂熱（Anarchic Zeal）的完整持續時間 ![](/data/assets/guide/c47191eac4c3da8b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fspike-guard.png)尖刺守衛（Spike Guard）將為你對每個目標恢復約 50 點生命值。

* 結合傷害減免效果，這使得 ![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)災害（Hazard）變得更加硬朗，並減輕了你 ![](/data/assets/guide/28f559449d0692f6.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Fsupport.svg)支援（Supports）的治療資源需求。
搭配重組（Reconstitution）使用
* 當計畫使用無政府狂熱（Anarchic Zeal）時，你應該選擇重組（Reconstitution）作為你的次要特殊能力（minor perks），以充分利用吸血效果。

* ![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)災害（Hazard）可以在持有 ![](/data/assets/guide/c47191eac4c3da8b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fspike-guard.png)尖刺守衛（Spike Guard）時，將敵人困在自己身體與 ![](/data/assets/guide/860a1f6211acadb3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjagged-wall.png)鋸齒之牆（Jagged Wall）之間的角落裡。

* 每隔幾秒，他們就會再次觸發 ![](/data/assets/guide/860a1f6211acadb3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjagged-wall.png)鋸齒之牆（Jagged Wall）和重組（Reconstitution）的能量回充。享受看著他們驚慌失措，同時你緩慢地吸乾他們的生命吧。

5.2.1.title: 重組（Reconstitution）
5.2.1.description: 鋸齒之牆（Jagged Wall）命中時會為尖刺護衛（Spike Guard）充能 25 點能量，最多可額外獲得 50 點。
content: * 顯著提升了運作時間

* 在閱讀此特殊能力（Perk）說明時，你可能會覺得它聽起來很弱。然而，重組（Reconstitution）之所以強大，是因為 ![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)災害（Hazard）會先消耗基礎的 ![](/data/assets/guide/c47191eac4c3da8b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fspike-guard.png)尖刺護衛（Spike Guard）資源，才會開始消耗溢出的能量。此外，溢出的能量不會衰減，因此你可以視需求隨時保留它。

* 透過瞬間回填與溢出機制，你將能更頻繁地使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/c47191eac4c3da8b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fspike-guard.png)尖刺護衛（Spike Guard），或是延長其使用時間。

5.2.2.title: 爆裂穿刺
5.2.2.description: 骨刺（Bonespur）擊中目標會附著尖刺。快速近戰（Quick Melee）與暴力躍擊（Violent Leap）的斬擊會引爆尖刺，造成 40 點爆炸傷害。
content: * 額外爆發傷害

* 對於與隊友配合擊殺或單獨擊殺目標非常有幫助。你不需要做任何額外的操作，因為所有 ![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)災害（Hazard）玩家本來就應該使用上述提到的「射擊 > 躍擊 > 近戰」連招。基本上，這等於是免費的額外 40 點傷害。

6.title: 地圖
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)災害（Hazard）的機動性在擁有大量牆面可供攀爬，以及具備豐富高台的地圖上能發揮最大效益。由於他的射程有限，在擁有大片開闊區域與長視線的地圖上，他的遊玩風格會受到限制。他也喜歡利用轉角與結構來部署他的突襲行動，因此擁有區隔化區域的地圖能為他提供更多機會。另一個能幫助 ![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)災害（Hazard）大放異彩的地圖特徵是狹窄的隘口與門口。在敵方隊伍必須通過這些狹窄區域的地圖上，![](/data/assets/guide/860a1f6211acadb3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjagged-wall.png)鋸齒之牆（Jagged Wall）能發揮極大作用，透過阻斷敵方動線來輕鬆主導戰局。

7.title: 隊伍陣容搭配
content: 圍繞 ![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)災害（Hazard）建立的隊伍陣容，可以針對他的移動、誘敵與強勢開戰做出快速反應。由於 ![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)災害（Hazard）需要不斷變換位置，機動性或射程有限的英雄很難與他配合。此外，他無法為隊伍提供太多保護，也沒有足夠的移動範圍來保護後排，因此隊友需要具備一定的自保能力。不過，由於 ![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)災害（Hazard）並非完全的陣地戰或機動型 ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)坦克，在英雄選擇上仍保有一定的靈活性。
圍繞災害（Hazard）建立的隊伍陣容範例：

* 坦克：![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)災害（Hazard）、![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅（Zarya）

* 輸出：![](/data/assets/guide/9d5aac4b0dd47287.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Ffreja.png)弗蕾亞（Freja）、![](/data/assets/guide/47ceb39c2ed21da9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fventure.png)無畏（Venture）

* 輔助：![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)霧子（Kiriko）、![](/data/assets/guide/3d1103aaa0893433.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Flucio.png)路西歐（Lúcio）

7.1.title: 與其他英雄的個人協同效應
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/9d5aac4b0dd47287.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Ffreja.png)弗蕾亞（Freja）

* ![](/data/assets/guide/9d5aac4b0dd47287.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Ffreja.png)弗蕾亞的衝刺與垂直機動性，讓她能輕鬆協助![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)災害（Hazard）進行強勢開戰。當他正在佈局時，![](/data/assets/guide/9d5aac4b0dd47287.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Ffreja.png)弗蕾亞也非常擅長施加遠程壓力，為他的突擊創造空間。他們只需要協調技能使用的時機，因為如果![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)災害用![](/data/assets/guide/860a1f6211acadb3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjagged-wall.png)鋸齒之牆（Jagged Wall）將敵人困在背後，![](/data/assets/guide/9d5aac4b0dd47287.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Ffreja.png)弗蕾亞必須確保有衝刺技能可用，才能以爆炸弩箭（Explosive Bolts）轟擊目標。
路西歐（Lúcio）

* 路西歐擁有能與![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)災害並肩作戰的速度與靈活性。當![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)災害獨自執行任務、試圖孤立敵方後排時，路西歐也不難維持自身生存。![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)災害在投入戰鬥後，有時會難以脫離戰場。路西歐的速度增益能讓![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)災害更快進入位置，也能更有效地協助他撤退至安全地帶。
![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)霧子（Kiriko）

* 由於沒有護盾且在格擋時必須站定，![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)災害經常會受到昏迷與禁療效果的影響。![](/data/assets/guide/617631df12ff0fc7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprotection-suzu.png)保護鈴（Protection Suzu）在這些情況下至關重要，往往會成為![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)災害唯一的生存希望。此外，![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)霧子可以與![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)災害一同進行侵略性攻擊，隨後立即傳送撤離，直到下一次突擊。

8.title: 如何反制
content: 有效反制 ![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)災害（Hazard）有幾個步驟。如果你想存活下來，就必須設法應對他的 ![](/data/assets/guide/860a1f6211acadb3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjagged-wall.png)鋸齒之牆（Jagged Wall）和 ![](/data/assets/guide/121d222c0195922b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fviolent-leap.png)暴力跳躍（Violent Leap）。機動性較差的英雄很容易成為他的目標，被他放置在身後的牆壁隔開，與隊伍斷絕聯繫，這無異於判了死刑。在這種情況下，擁有跳躍或逃生能力的英雄生存起來會輕鬆許多。

要應對跳躍和 ![](/data/assets/guide/c47191eac4c3da8b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fspike-guard.png)尖刺護衛（Spike Guard），你最好的工具就是擊退和暈眩。他的跳躍距離並不遠，且他的 ![](/data/assets/guide/e333ac66d1d49141.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbonespur.png)骨刺（Bonespur）射程有限，因此只要將他擊退或定在原地，他的威脅性就會大幅降低。

* 額外提示：![](/data/assets/guide/eeafb396dbd4850f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdownpour.png)傾盆大雨（Downpour）本質上是一個垂直投射物，所以如果你能在頭頂上方放置屏障，就能夠阻擋它。
